lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular 2D grid of high-luminance circular clusters arranged in vertical columns. Posterior to the gills, columns typically contain 4-5 nodes with roughly equidistant vertical spacing and increasing diameter towards the ventral midline.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the centroids of the circular blobs, particularly visible in the mid-flank, forming a structured grid pattern of anchor nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal ridge is visible in the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient in pixel intensity with a highlight on the superior edge and a shadow on the inferior edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Approximately 7-9 high-luminance blobs are distributed across the macro-mask of the first dorsal fin, with a higher concentration observed near the posterior trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct irregular notch or missing tissue section is visible at the apex (tip) of the first dorsal fin.
other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin displays a unique high-density clustering of smaller, discrete spots concentrated along its anterior and distal margins.
